shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json AGENTS.md && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui -R | head -50

find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -30 && cat src/*.tsx index.html | head -120; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster ThemeProvider Button

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button 2>&1 | head -60; sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | grep -n -i -E "toast|Button view|Icon data"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "toast" README.md | head -40; ls; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -ipath "*toaster*" -name "*.d.ts" -print | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat types.d.ts Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts hooks/useToaster.d.ts index.d.ts
cat constants.d.ts Toaster.d.ts; grep -n "autoHiding\|DEFAULT" ../../../esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js | head; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat tsconfig.json
